pressureChamber.concept: independent pressure chamber reconstruction, not a published Tesla underbody drawing

tests.test: Every authored position and normal is finite; nonzero normals are unit length
Full suspension travel is represented directly, without shrinking or visually clamping tyres
Whole tyre sweep clears arch, roof, inner wheelhouse and isolated thrust duct
Continuous pressure chamber has an airtight roof, isolated wheel/jet cutouts and surface-following seal
Cabin glazing, body aperture, individual LED lenses and suspension articulation exist
Pressed door has interior surface samples and each lamp is an actual opening in paint
All 20 physical seal segments and interpolation correction survive exterior rebuilding

limitations: A sampled geometric clearance test, not a tolerance stack-up or deformable tyre contact analysis.
Suspension links and pressure chamber are independently authored layouts, not OEM CAD or measured suspension kinematics.
Full tyre travel envelope is guaranteed only for the stated suspension and steering range.
